summary: Frontend-only test of Finance → Invoices status filter dropdown. Verified the two new filter options 'Voided' and 'Converted (Proforma)' are present, selectable, filter the list correctly, and 'All Invoices' restores the full list. GET /api/finance/invoices was called properly (all 200s). No console errors related to the feature.
critical_code_review_comments: InvoicesTab.jsx is 852 lines — consider splitting for maintainability (guideline: >700 lines).
Empty-state message uses raw status value (e.g. 'No invoices with status "voided"'). Consider using the human label ('Voided', 'Converted (Proforma)') for slightly nicer UX. Non-blocking.
seed_data_creation: None. Per instructions, no voided/converted invoices were created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Path to reach Invoices tab: login → auto-redirects to /calendar → click 'Dashboard' → lands on /admin (Admin Dashboard) → click 'Finance' pill tab → click 'Open Finance Portal' button OR navigate directly to /finance. Then click the 'Invoices' tab. Status filter is a Radix Select combobox. All 9 options confirmed: All Invoices, Pending, Draft, Approved, Issued, Paid, Cancelled, Voided, Converted (Proforma).

verification_evidence.voided_filter_empty_state: No invoices with status "voided". Try changing the filter.
verification_evidence.converted_filter_empty_state: No invoices with status "converted". Try changing the filter.
verification_evidence.all_invoices_view: Shows 4 invoices in April 2026 (Draft, Paid, Issued, Issued) — total RM 16,440.00
api_calls: GET /api/finance/invoices → 200 (client fetches all invoices then filters client-side)
verification_evidence.console_errors_related_to_feature: None (only unrelated 404/403 for other static resources)
